questions.prompt: Compare aerobic and anaerobic respiration in human muscle.
questions.modelAnswer: Aerobic respiration needs oxygen and breaks glucose down completely into carbon dioxide and water, releasing a lot of energy (as ATP), mostly in the mitochondria. Anaerobic respiration happens when oxygen is short; glucose is broken down only partly to lactic acid, releasing much less energy, and the lactic acid causes fatigue and cramps.
rubric: Products: CO₂ + water vs lactic acid
